additional_info.body:
Dear Vaishnavy,
My colleague went on-site last week and checked the payment terminal and its cables as you described in the previous email.
Network cable defect or not connected
The cable was fine and tested, it was switched from other charger where worked fine.
There was no ping at
10.20.17.50
even when we connected our cable directly from Laptop→Payment.
Network switch defect
We have tested and scanned via MobaXterm at
XF2 switch
– this is the result:
We have tested and scanned via MobaXterm at
XF1 switch
– this is the result:
Power supply of payment terminal defect or not connected
Measured
24V
on the input terminal.
IP-address of payment terminal wrong
This might be the problem. As I attached the original picture (attaching again) of the payment terminal after power on it seems it is like stucked on the boot screen, maybe a problem with the bootloader.
This is why I would need some further support how to work with the terminal in order to set it to the working state. But if this is not in our competence I would prefer to exchange the payment terminal with working one.
Please may I ask you for any further support? This case has been opened almost 2 months without any progress and we would love to have a solution since the customer is, fortunately, very patient.
Thank you
BR Tomas Cepicka
